//: SECRETS ARE NOT STORED IN THIS FILE.
Supply them as environment variables (Coolify -> Environment Variables).
Nested keys use a double underscore:
Jwt__SigningKey                      = <at least 32 bytes; generate with: openssl rand -base64 48>
Auth__Bootstrap__Password            = <first admin password; clear after first run>
Telegram__BotToken                   = <from BotFather; absent turns Telegram off>
Auth__TelegramWebhookSecret          = <shared secret Telegram echoes back on each update>
Rotating the signing key: move the old value into Jwt__PreviousSigningKeys__0,
set the new one in Jwt__SigningKey, redeploy, then remove the old entry once
//AllowedHosts: Host header allow-list. A request whose Host is not here gets 400 before it reaches a controller, and that INCLUDES the container health check, which calls in on localhost — a list without localhost makes the container read as unhealthy and the proxy answers 502 for the whole site. Keep localhost, and add every public name the site answers on. Override per deployment with the AllowedHosts environment variable.
